tasks.title: Scaffold Rust CLI and Image Loading
tasks.desc: Initialize Cargo project, setup CLI arguments with Clap (files, --width, --height, --max-width, --max-height, --protocol, --quiet, --watch), and implement image decoding supporting PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF from both file paths and stdin.

notes.text: Plan: Initialize Cargo project, configure dependencies (clap, image, base64, etc.), create CLI arguments structure, and implement image loading from file paths and stdin.
Initialized Cargo project, configured Clap CLI arguments with sizing/protocol/watch/quiet flags, and implemented image loading with automatic format detection and STDIN support.

tasks.title: Implement Terminal Detection & Multiplexer Passthrough
tasks.desc: Detect terminal graphics capabilities via /dev/tty DA/graphics queries and environment variables (Kitty, iTerm2/WezTerm/Ghostty). Detect tmux/screen and wrap escape sequences in passthrough commands. Return clear error guidance when no supported graphics protocol is available.

notes.text: Plan: Implement terminal emulator and protocol detection (Kitty, iTerm2/WezTerm/Ghostty) via environment and direct TTY query, along with tmux/screen multiplexer detection and escape passthrough wrapper.

Implemented terminal protocol detection (Kitty, iTerm2) with environment lookup and /dev/tty fallback, tmux/screen multiplexer detection and escape passthrough wrapping, and error reporting for unsupported terminals.

tasks.title: Implement Kitty Graphics Protocol Encoder
tasks.desc: Implement Kitty graphics protocol transmission: chunked base64 payload delivery, direct RGB/RGBA or PNG pass-through, dimension calculation, and escape formatting.

notes.text: Plan: Implement Kitty graphics protocol encoder: chunked base64 payload delivery (4096-byte chunks), format selection (PNG passthrough or 32-bit RGBA), dimension control (columns/rows), and escape sequences.
Implemented Kitty graphics protocol encoder with 4096-byte chunked base64 transmission, PNG format passthrough, dimension control, and multiplexer wrapping support.

tasks.title: Implement iTerm2 Inline Protocol Encoder
tasks.desc: Implement iTerm2 inline images protocol: base64 payload encoding, file size and dimension parameters (width, height, preserveAspectRatio=1), and escape formatting.

notes.text: Plan: Implement iTerm2 inline images protocol: base64 payload encoding, dimension arguments (width, height, preserveAspectRatio=1), size metadata, and OSC 1337 escape sequence generation.
Implemented iTerm2 inline images protocol encoder with OSC 1337 sequences, base64 payload encoding, dimension formatting, and multiplexer wrapping.

tasks.title: Unified Sizing and Rendering Engine
tasks.desc: Query current terminal window dimensions (columns and rows), calculate scaled target dimensions preserving aspect ratio, and render image buffers to terminal stdout using the selected protocol.

notes.text: Plan: Implement terminal dimension calculation, size parsing (cols, rows, percentages), aspect ratio preservation, image format conversion to PNG when needed for Kitty, and dispatch to selected graphics protocol.
Implemented unified sizing and rendering engine with terminal window detection, aspect ratio preservation, automatic format conversion to PNG for Kitty, and protocol dispatch.

tasks.title: Sequential Multi-Image & Metadata Banner
tasks.desc: Support processing multiple image arguments sequentially. Print formatted metadata header (filename, resolution, size) above each image, suppressed with --quiet.

notes.text: Plan: Enhance multi-image display with clean ANSI-styled metadata banners (file name in bold, dimensions, format, file size), proper spacing, and support for quiet mode.
Implemented sequential multi-image rendering with styled ANSI metadata banners, clean visual separation, and quiet mode flag handling.

tasks.title: In-Place Live Watch Mode
tasks.desc: Implement --watch / -W mode to monitor image file changes on disk and re-render plots in place with clear terminal cursor positioning as training scripts update them.

notes.text: Plan: Implement file watcher using notify crate, re-rendering in-place (clearing screen or moving cursor to top-left) on file modification, and handling Ctrl+C gracefully.
Implemented --watch / -W live watch mode with in-place terminal screen/cursor updating, Kitty image buffer clearing, filesystem event debouncing, and stdin validation.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing & Documentation
tasks.desc: Create unit and integration test suite with synthetic raster images, test CLI piping and flags, and write README with remote server setup and usage guide.

notes.text: Plan: Create comprehensive integration tests (synthetic image generation for PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, stdin piping, CLI flag checks), verify release build, and write comprehensive README documentation.

Completed full test suite and documentation:
- 13 unit tests covering terminal protocol detection, multiplexer wrapping, size parsing, Kitty chunking, and iTerm2 OSC 1337 generation.
- 6 integration tests verifying real end-to-end binary execution with synthetic PNG/JPEG images, STDIN piping, multi-image sequences, and quiet mode.
- Optimized release build verified (target/release/climg, ~2.7 MB standalone static binary).
- Comprehensive README.md created with compatibility table, remote SSH setup, and usage examples.
